command:
set -euo pipefail
MID=${LOCAL_BRIDGE_MACHINE_ID:-}
OWN=${LOCAL_BRIDGE_OWNER:-}
[ "$MID" = "ai-core-node" ] || { echo "wrong machine binding: $MID" >&2; exit 40; }
[ "$OWN" = "gabriel" ] || { echo "wrong owner binding: $OWN" >&2; exit 40; }
echo KERNEL_HOSTNAME=$(hostname)
echo MACHINE_ID=$MID OWNER=$OWN
DB=/home/ai-core-node/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db
[ -s "$DB" ] || { echo "canonical DB missing: $DB" >&2; exit 41; }
VOICE_PID_BEFORE=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p MainPID --value || true)
[ -n "$VOICE_PID_BEFORE" ] || VOICE_PID_BEFORE=0
echo VOICE_PID_BEFORE=$VOICE_PID_BEFORE
if ss -ltnH 'sport = :8765' | grep -q .; then
  echo 'port 8765 already occupied; refusing ambiguous client start' >&2
  ss -ltnp 'sport = :8765' >&2 || true
  exit 42
fi
CFG_DIR=$HOME/.config/frankenstein
ENVF=$CFG_DIR/chatgpt-client.env
mkdir -p "$CFG_DIR"
umask 077
TOKEN=''
if [ -f "$ENVF" ]; then TOKEN=$(sed -n 's/^FRANK_VOICE_BROKER_TOKEN=//p' "$ENVF" | head -n1 || true); fi
if [ -z "$TOKEN" ]; then TOKEN=$(python3 - <<'PY'
import secrets
print(secrets.token_urlsafe(48))
PY
); fi
TMP=$(mktemp "$CFG_DIR/.chatgpt-client.env.XXXXXX")
cat >"$TMP" <<EOF
FRANK_VOICE_MACHINE_ID=ai-core-node
FRANK_VOICE_OWNER=gabriel
FRANK_VOICE_PERSON=gabriel
FRANK_VOICE_DB_PATH=$DB
FRANK_VOICE_BROKER_TOKEN=$TOKEN
FRANK_VOICE_BROKER_BIND=127.0.0.1
FRANK_VOICE_BROKER_PORT=8765
FRANK_CHATGPT_SESSION_TTL_S=1800
FRANK_CHATGPT_MAX_SESSIONS=16
EOF
chmod 600 "$TMP"
mv "$TMP" "$ENVF"
cd /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo
git fetch origin chatgpt-work/voice-full-integration-20260912
WT=/tmp/frank-voice-deploy-20260912-1710
rm -rf "$WT"
git worktree add --detach "$WT" FETCH_HEAD >/dev/null
cleanup(){ git -C /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo worktree remove -f "$WT" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT
cd "$WT"
echo DEPLOY_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
bash scripts/install_voice_full_integration.sh
systemctl --user is-active --quiet frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service || { systemctl --user status --no-pager frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service >&2; exit 43; }
CLIENT_PID=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p MainPID --value)
echo CLIENT_PID=$CLIENT_PID
HEALTH=$(curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://127.0.0.1:8765/health)
python3 - "$HEALTH" <<'PY'
import json,sys
x=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); assert x['ok'] is True; assert x['machine_id']=='ai-core-node' and x['owner']=='gabriel' and x['person']=='gabriel'; assert x['persistent_client'] is True; print('HEALTH_OK machine_id=%s owner=%s person=%s active_sessions=%s' % (x['machine_id'],x['owner'],x['person'],x['active_sessions']))
PY
SID=smoke-gabriel-$(date +%s)
OPEN=$(curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"session_id\":\"$SID\"}" http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1/session/open)
python3 - "$OPEN" <<'PY'
import json,sys
x=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); s=x['session']; assert x['ok'] is True and s['identity_state']=='IDENTITY_REQUIRED' and s['selected_person'] is None; print('OPEN_OK identity_state=IDENTITY_REQUIRED selected_person=null')
PY
SELECT=$(curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"session_id\":\"$SID\",\"person\":\"gabriel\"}" http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1/session/select)
python3 - "$SELECT" <<'PY'
import json,sys
x=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); s=x['session']; assert x['ok'] is True and x['person']=='gabriel' and s['identity_state']=='BOUND'; print('SELECT_OK person=gabriel identity_state=BOUND runtime_epoch_id=%s' % s.get('runtime_epoch_id'))
PY
TURN=$(curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"session_id\":\"$SID\",\"query\":\"Wer bist du und mit wem sprichst du gerade?\",\"char_budget\":1800}" http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1/session/turn-context)
python3 - "$TURN" <<'PY'
import json,sys
x=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); assert x['ok'] is True and x['person']=='gabriel'; a=x.get('identity_active_assembly',''); assert 'FranKenstein' in a and 'gabriel' in a.lower(); assert 'titan_context' in x and 'state' in x; print('TURN_CONTEXT_OK identity_bytes=%d titan_bytes=%d emergent_bytes=%d' % (len(a),len(x.get('titan_context','')),len(x.get('emergent_context',''))))
PY
CLOSE=$(curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"session_id\":\"$SID\",\"reason\":\"smoke_complete\"}" http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1/session/close)
python3 - "$CLOSE" <<'PY'
import json,sys
x=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); assert x['ok'] is True and x['closed'] is True; print('CLOSE_OK')
PY
VOICE_PID_AFTER=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p MainPID --value || true)
echo VOICE_PID_AFTER=$VOICE_PID_AFTER
[ "$VOICE_PID_BEFORE" = "$VOICE_PID_AFTER" ] || { echo 'conversation service PID changed unexpectedly' >&2; exit 44; }
if pstree -ap "$CLIENT_PID" 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'chrome|chromium' >/dev/null; then echo 'client spawned browser descendant' >&2; exit 45; fi
echo NO_VOICE_RESTART=PASS
echo CLIENT_BROWSER_DESCENDANTS=0
echo DEPLOYMENT=PASS
